results.response_excerpt: To improve your soil with composting, you can follow the guidance provided in the YonEarth resources. In the "Soil Stewardship Handbook," Chapter 8.0 emphasizes the use of compost tea and bokashi to supercharge your plants, gardens, and yards. Compost tea can be made by soaking compost in non-chlorinated water for several hours before spreading it on your soil. Bokashi, on the other hand, is made by fermenting organic fruit waste and organic grain waste in an enclosed, aqueous environment. These natural liquid fertilizers are rich in beneficial microorganisms that can enhance soil health and fertility. By incorporating compost tea and bokashi into your soil management practices, you can promote a thriving soil ecosystem and support the growth of healthy plants.
